Tab5 browser fixtures

Every endpoint below is reachable from here with a relative link, which is itself part of what is being tested.

Documents that should render

  • simple.html - the shortest complete page
  • long.html - many paragraphs, for scrolling
  • headings.html - h1 through h6
  • list.html - nested ul and ol
  • pre.html - preformatted text
  • entity.html - character references
  • utf8.html - non-ASCII text
  • inline.html - strong, em, code
  • image.html - img alt handling
  • rule.html - hr
  • script.html - script and style bodies
  • empty.html - a document with no text
  • links/ - relative reference resolution

Character encodings

  • encoding/shift-jis - declared by the header
  • encoding/shift-jis-meta - declared by meta
  • encoding/shift-jis-lying-meta - header over meta
  • encoding/shift-jis-broken - one dangling lead byte
  • encoding/utf8-bom.html - a byte order mark

Media types

  • plain.txt - text/plain, shown as itself
  • plain-sjis.txt - text/plain in Shift_JIS
  • notatype.bin - neither HTML nor text, refused

Malformed markup that should still render

  • broken/unclosed.html
  • broken/deep-nest.html
  • broken/huge-attribute.html
  • broken/bad-utf8.html

Transfers

  • slow - one byte at a time
  • chunked - chunk boundaries move every request
  • chunked-trailer - extensions and a trailer
  • chunked-bad - a chunk size that is not hex
  • gzip - Content-Encoding this cannot decode

Redirects

  • redirect/301
  • redirect/302
  • redirect/307
  • redirect/308
  • redirect/relative
  • redirect/chain/5 - inside the limit
  • redirect/chain/6 - past the limit
  • redirect/loop
  • redirect/https

Failures

  • fail/truncate-body
  • fail/truncate-head
  • fail/big-header
  • fail/length-over - more body than promised
  • fail/length-under - less body than promised
  • fail/no-status
  • status/404
  • status/500

Limits

  • limit/input - past MAX_DECODED_HTML_BYTES
  • limit/input-nolength - the same without a length
  • limit/text - past MAX_TEXT_BYTES
  • limit/items - past MAX_ITEMS
  • limit/links - excess links become plain text
  • limit/url - a link past MAX_URL_BYTES
  • limit/longline - one unbreakable line

Plain downloads

  • download/64k.bin
  • download/512k.bin - the httpget regression

manifest.txt lists all of this with the outcome each endpoint is supposed to produce, including the CRC-32 of the two downloads above.
